name: Yuunagi-sou no S-kyuu no Kanojo-tachi
original_name: 夕凪荘のＳ級の彼女たち
source:
[b]Yuunagi-sou—[/b]

A curious old villa.
Guarded by some strange force, it kept regular folks at bay.

Nestled in the city's heart, Yuunagi-sou is like a whisper hidden within a bamboo thicket...

＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊
Home mainly to women, including its caretaker, the place had its quirks.
Indeed, they're all breathtaking, yet there's more to them than meets the eye.

They are the elite—[b]S-class[/b] beauties.
＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊

[b]Saikawa Rin[/b] returned to his roots after ages and was apartment hunting when he found Yuunagi-sou.
The place was ancient but charming, and the tenants were a sight for sore eyes, so he jumped at the chance to move in.

Rin hadn't yet realized that the villa was exclusive to the elite.
Little does he know, he is already one of them—an [b]S-class boy[/b].

[Translated from the [url=https://www.moon-stone.jp/product2/msc03/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
[b]夕凪庄——[/b]

一栋引人好奇的古老别墅。
它被某种奇异力量守护着，寻常人无法靠近。
夕凪庄藏在城市中心，宛如竹林深处的一缕低语……

＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊
这栋宅邸主要住着女性，包括管理人，处处都透着几分古怪。
没错，她们个个美得惊人，但也各有不为人知的一面。

她们都是精英——[b]S级[/b]美女。
＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊－＊

[b]Saikawa Rin[/b]阔别多年回到故乡，正在寻找公寓时发现了夕凪庄。
宅邸虽然古老，却别有韵味；住户们也赏心悦目，他便立刻抓住机会搬了进去。

Rin还不知道，这栋别墅只接纳精英。
他更不知道，自己早已是其中一员——一位[b]S级男生[/b]。

[译自[url=https://www.moon-stone.jp/product2/msc03/#story]官方网站[/url]]
